entries.topic: Owner reports HTTP500 for D172 v1 login using shared Firebase Inventory accounts
facts: Owner reports all attempted logins on signed obpp1291-v1 fail with generic service HTTP500, without supplying credentials or session tokens. Real provider exception cause cannot be proven because Cloudflare Worker tail/runtime exception logs are not accessible in connected tooling.

Canonical E001/E006 allows only registered ACTIVE ADMIN/PICKPACK_ADMIN/ROOT role/base role, same registered InventoryCore/Firebase credentials; raw unregistered Firebase Auth users or PICKER/REPORTER must remain denied. OBPP issues a dedicated generation and may not replace existing Web/Android/Agent session.

Source audit proves login /api/obpp1291/session/login lacked the common Inventory Web ensureFirebasePasswordReady/legacy migration path, lacked retirePrivilegedStaticPassword and ensureFirebaseUid for special one-time accounts, and returned generic HTTP500 for uncaught InventoryCore/Firebase activate/sign/exchange failures.

Android v1 hid returned JSON.error for all failed HTTP responses, incorrectly interpreted unauthenticated login 401 as expired session, and did not offer existing /api/auth/privileged-code request UI; this obscured diagnosis for Owner.

Worker code-only candidate reuses Inventory shared Firebase password/legacy login readiness, keeps existing privileged OTP proof and role restrictions, authorizes ONLY /obpp1291/session/activate, assigns stable public stage-coded 503 and sanitized server stage logging, with no passwords/user identifiers/tokens in logs.

Android code-only candidate displays only allowlisted server error identifier and action-specific 401/403, offers explicit existing one-time privileged-code request, and changes no Inventory Android client or auto-poll/OTA channels.

Potential regression/security: Firebase readiness migration can touch only shared registered account Auth status as existing Web login does; D172 still never changes Web/Android/Agent session generation. Do NOT deploy before exact-head CI, impact review and a new executable source release receipt. Old D172 E006 authorization does not by itself attest the modified Worker source or physical field PASS.
